synopsis: Ordinary days are precious. A relaxed country life with Yeti! Hana Tanaka is a first-year high school student. Though there aren't any major changes, she embarks with the Yeti to explore the small “sparks of joy” in her daily life!

However, Yukie, an office lady, and Sachiko, the manager of a lesbian bar, have opposite life schedules, so they even though they live in the same house, it's like they live apart from each other. synopsis: A legendary god-tier game, "Dungeon Job Hunting Recommendation", aka "DanKatsu", features an unprecedented 1,021 playable job classes and over 400 different endings! The more you play, the stronger you become, unlocking new abilities and rare items. One dedicated gamer (PN: Zephyrus) finds himself reincarnated as the protagonist of this very game! Overjoyed at the chance to experience it in real life, he immediately enrolls in the Labyrinth Academy—the game's main stage. Armed with his extensive knowledge of the game's mechanics, he aims to obtain the ultimate class: Hero. Not only that, but he also guides his timid childhood friend toward the Alchemist class, allowing the two of them to breeze through the academy's curriculum and rapidly level up! Powerful jobs, legendary loot, and epic rewards—secured at lightning speed! (Source: TO Books, translated)
